subject: Payband flex request for Lena Torres — staff platform candidate
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: payband flex + sign-on for Lena Torres (Staff Platform)

Hi Grace / Markus —

We have an offer situation that needs an out-of-band approval to close a high-priority staff platform candidate, Lena Torres (currently at Quantly AI). Quick summary:

- Role: Staff Platform Engineer, hiring manager: Grace O'Connor
- Base band (target): $180k–$220k (US West)
- Standard comp package proposed: Base $220,000 + 0.5% equity over 4 years + standard relocation allowance
- Candidate expectation / competitor counter: $235,000 base + 0.6% + $30k sign-on (counter from an enterprise vendor)

Why this is urgent: Lena has critical infra experience (LLM serving/runtime) and two internal teams are lined up to rely on her for the runtime rollout planned for H1. We already had a strong on-site and reference checks. Recruiter Will confirms she is likely to accept only if the base is bumped and there is a one-time sign-on.

Ask: Approval to offer an out-of-band base of $235,000 (approx 7% above top of band), plus a one-time sign-on $30,000 and a one-time equity refresh of 0.1% (on-boarding uplift) to make the total package competitive. Total incremental annualized comp impact (run-rate) is modest since sign-on is one-time; equity refresh is amortized.

Justification bullets:
- Candidate brings infra + LLM serving experience, proven latency/cost wins at scale (see resume attached).
- Hiring urgency aligns to product commit (runtime launch Q1).
- Market comps in attached benchmark sheet show similar hires paying out-of-band in this market.

Next steps: If you can confirm approval (full or partial), I will update the offer letter and get HR to prepare. If we cannot flex base, a combination of increased equity refresh + larger sign-on could be an alternative.

Attachments: lena_torres_resume.pdf, comp_market_benchmarks_Q3.xlsx, offer_summary_draft.docx

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: payband flex + sign-on for Lena Torres (Staff Platform)

Thanks Marissa — good summary. I strongly endorse making Lena an offer we can close on; she maps to the exact skills we need for the serving runtime. A couple of asks before final approval:

1) Markus — can you confirm whether we can do the full $235k base or whether finance requires moderating base and shifting to sign-on/equity?
2) Marissa — please confirm the hiring timeline (target start date) and whether this hire will replace an open headcount or is incremental against our Q4 hiring plan (impacts budget).

If we get a quick greenlight, I want to extend today so we have momentum.

- Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Inference Platform
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: payband flex + sign-on for Lena Torres (Staff Platform)

Marissa / Grace — appreciate the context. I reviewed the comps and spoke briefly with Finance. Summary of what I can approve without further escalation:

- One-time sign-on up to $25,000: APPROVED
- One-time equity refresh up to 0.15%: APPROVED
- Base above band: We need CFO sign-off for any base that exceeds the top of band by more than 5%. $235k is ~6.8% above top of band, so I cannot approve full $235k without CFO sign-off.

Recommended compromise to close quickly: Offer base at $230,000 (approx 4.5% over top of band) + $25k sign-on + 0.15% equity refresh. That stays within a tolerance I can sign for, and combined total should be competitive. If Grace believes the $235k is a must-have, escalate to finance (I can loop in Tara) — but expect an extra 24–48 hours for approval.

Also ensure the job is coded as a priority hire against hiring plan H2-2026 and include the cost-center override in the offer packet. I note this is an incremental headcount (not a replacement) — please include budget owner sign-off.

Markus Klein
Head of People Operations
markus.klein@redwood.ai

[attachment: comp_market_benchmarks_Q3.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Torres <lena.torres@quantly.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Will Hartmann <will@talentbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Offer update: Redwood Inference — Staff Platform Engineer

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for taking the time to speak with the team. We really enjoyed meeting you and believe you are an excellent fit for the Staff Platform role. We're excited to move forward and wanted to share the current offer terms while we finalize the paperwork:

- Base salary: $230,000
- One-time sign-on: $25,000 (paid in first payroll after start)
- Equity: 0.65% total (0.5% standard grant + 0.15% one-time onboarding refresh, 4-year vest schedule)
- Target start date: Oct 18, 2026 (flexible)

This package was approved by People Ops and is aligned to the business priority. Please review and let me know if you have questions; we hope to receive your decision within 72 hours so we can lock in your start details.

Next steps: If accepted, HR will send the formal offer letter and onboarding checklist (I have attached a draft). Will, thanks for coordinating the timelines with Lena.

Attachments: offer_summary_draft.docx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
